_note: 學習路徑內容建置第8批 #4／6：too…to／enough to／so…that／such…that（eng.t_mid.adjadv.too-enough-so-such，會考級／中階）。too ＋ adj ＋ to V（太…以致不能）；adj ＋ enough ＋ to V（enough 放形容詞後）；so ＋ adj/adv ＋ that ＋ 子句；such ＋ (a/an) ＋ adj ＋ 名詞 ＋ that。誘答以『該字搭配在此結構不合法』鎖唯一正解——so 不接 a+名詞、such 要接名詞、too 配 to 不配 that、enough 要放形容詞後。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核（每選項代入 stem 驗唯一正解、play-through 朗讀）。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix toe_）。

units.can_do: 我能用 too ＋ 形容詞 ＋ to V（太…以致不能）、形容詞 ＋ enough ＋ to V（足夠…可以）、so ＋ 形容詞/副詞 ＋ that ＋ 子句、such ＋ (a/an) ＋ 形容詞 ＋ 名詞 ＋ that ＋ 子句，正確表達程度與結果，並分辨 so（接形容詞）與 such（接名詞片語）、too（配 to）與 so（配 that）。
units.situation_group: 形容詞與副詞 Degree and result: too / enough / so / such
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'too + adjective + to-infinitive' means more than is wanted, with a negative result: 'The coffee is too hot to drink' (= so hot that you cannot drink it).
claims.verification_ref: too ＋ 形容詞 ＋ to V＝太…不能…；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'adjective + enough + to-infinitive' means there is as much as is needed; 'enough' comes after the adjective: 'tall enough to reach the shelf'.
claims.verification_ref: 形容詞 ＋ enough ＋ to V；enough 放形容詞後面；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'so + adjective/adverb + that + clause' shows a degree and its result: 'He ran so fast that no one could catch him'.
claims.verification_ref: so ＋ 形容詞/副詞 ＋ that ＋ 子句；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'such + (a/an) + adjective + noun + that + clause' shows a degree with a noun phrase: 'It was such a good film that we watched it twice'.
claims.verification_ref: such ＋ (a/an) ＋ 形容詞 ＋ 名詞 ＋ that；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'so' goes with an adjective or adverb alone, while 'such' goes with a noun phrase: 'so good' but 'such a good book'.
claims.verification_ref: so＋形容詞/副詞、such＋名詞片語；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: too + adjective + to V means 'so ... that you cannot ...' (a negative result): The coffee is too hot to drink. adjective + enough + to V means '... enough to ...', and enough goes after the adjective: tall enough to reach.
teach.zh_hint: too ＋ 形容詞 ＋ to V＝「太…以致不能…」（結果是否定的）：The coffee is too hot to drink（咖啡太燙，不能喝）。形容詞 ＋ enough ＋ to V＝「夠…可以…」——enough 放在形容詞「後面」：tall enough to reach（夠高可以搆到）。

teach.body: The soup was too hot to eat, so I waited until it was cool enough to drink.
teach.zh_hint: 湯太燙不能吃，所以我等到它涼到可以喝。too hot to eat／cool enough to drink。

teach.body: so + adjective/adverb + that + clause means 'so ... that ...': The test was so difficult that many students could not finish. Note that so is followed directly by an adjective or adverb.
teach.zh_hint: so ＋ 形容詞／副詞 ＋ that ＋ 子句＝「如此…以致…」：The test was so difficult that many students could not finish（考試難到很多學生寫不完）。注意 so 後面直接接形容詞／副詞。

teach.body: He ran so fast that no one in the class could catch him.
teach.zh_hint: 他跑得好快，班上沒人追得上。so fast that…。

teach.body: such + (a/an) + adjective + noun + that + clause means 'such a ... that ...': It was such a good film that we watched it twice. Difference: so takes an adjective, such takes a noun phrase.
teach.zh_hint: such ＋ (a/an) ＋ 形容詞 ＋ 名詞 ＋ that ＋ 子句＝「如此…的（名詞）以致…」：It was such a good film that we watched it twice（那是部這麼好的電影，我們看了兩次）。差別：so 接形容詞，such 接「名詞片語」。

teach.body: It was such a beautiful day that we decided to have a picnic in the park.
teach.zh_hint: 那天天氣這麼好，我們決定去公園野餐。such a beautiful day that…。

practice.stem: 填入正確的字：The box was ____ heavy to lift by myself, so I asked a friend for help.（這個箱子太重，我一個人搬不動，所以我請朋友幫忙）

distractor_rationales.so: so 要配 that ＋ 子句（so heavy that I could not lift it），不配 to lift；配 to V 的是 too。
distractor_rationales.such: such 後面要接名詞片語（such a heavy box），不能直接接形容詞 heavy；這裡用 too。
distractor_rationales.enough: enough 要放在形容詞後面（heavy enough）且意思是『夠…』；太重搬不動用 too heavy to lift。

practice.feedback: 太…以致不能…用 too ＋ 形容詞 ＋ to V：too heavy to lift。

practice.stem: 填入正確的字：The water in the pool was warm ____ to swim in this morning.（今天早上池水夠溫暖，可以游泳）

distractor_rationales.too: too 放在形容詞前面（too warm）且意思是「太…不能…」；這裡是「夠溫暖可以游泳」，用形容詞後面的 enough。
distractor_rationales.so: so 要配 that ＋ 子句，不配 to swim；而且位置在形容詞前；這裡用 warm enough to swim。
distractor_rationales.such: such 接名詞片語，不接單一形容詞 warm；這裡用 enough。

practice.feedback: 夠…可以…用「形容詞 ＋ enough ＋ to V」：warm enough to swim in。

practice.stem: 填入正確的字：She spoke ____ quietly that we could not hear her from the back.（她說話好小聲，我們在後面聽不到她）

distractor_rationales.such: such 要接名詞片語（such a quiet voice），不接副詞 quietly；接 quietly ＋ that 用 so。
distractor_rationales.too: too 配 to V（too quietly to hear），不配 that ＋ 子句；這裡後面是 that we could not hear，用 so。
distractor_rationales.enough: enough 放在形容詞/副詞後面且配 to V；這裡後面是 that ＋ 子句，用 so quietly that。

practice.feedback: so ＋ 副詞 ＋ that ＋ 子句：so quietly that we could not hear her。

practice.stem: 填入正確的字：It was ____ an exciting game that the whole town came to watch.（那是一場這麼刺激的比賽，全鎮的人都來看）

distractor_rationales.so: so 接形容詞/副詞（so exciting），不接 a/an ＋ 形容詞 ＋ 名詞；後面是 an exciting game（名詞片語）要用 such。
distractor_rationales.too: too 配 to V 且不接 a/an ＋ 名詞；這裡是 such an exciting game that…。
distractor_rationales.very: very 只加強程度，不能配 that ＋ 子句表結果（×very an exciting game that）；用 such。

practice.feedback: such ＋ a/an ＋ 形容詞 ＋ 名詞 ＋ that：such an exciting game that the whole town came to watch。

practice.stem: 填入正確的字：The tea was ____ hot that I could not drink it for ten minutes.（茶好燙，我有十分鐘都沒辦法喝）

distractor_rationales.too: too 配 to V（too hot to drink），不配 that ＋ 子句；這裡後面是 that I could not drink，要用 so。
distractor_rationales.such: such 接名詞片語（such hot tea），不直接接形容詞 hot；接 hot ＋ that 用 so。
distractor_rationales.enough: enough 放形容詞後面且配 to V；這裡後面是 that ＋ 子句，用 so hot that。

practice.feedback: 後面接 that ＋ 子句用 so（not too）：so hot that I could not drink it。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: The bag was so heavy that I was too tired to carry it home.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：so heavy that（配 that 子句）和 too tired to carry（配 to V）兩個結構有沒有寫對，heavy／tired／home 有沒有漏，句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。too／so／such 稍強調點出程度，形容詞清楚，句尾下收。

lines.text: I was too tired to finish my homework last night.
lines.intonation: too tired to 連讀、tired 稍強調、句尾下收

lines.text: She is kind enough to help anyone who needs it.
lines.intonation: kind enough to 連讀、句尾下收
